candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Same Town01 route with slightly shifted spawn and moderate wet conditions; ego traverses an intersection with active red traffic lights and large puddles while vehicle_cmd remains zero despite ego motion, leading to an oracle red-light violation (collision remains incidental/uncertain).
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Preserve the original command–status mismatch and red-light violation pattern under similar mission and environment, while slightly perturbing mission start and puddle configuration to test robustness without changing the core unknown root cause.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Verify no additional dynamic actors are present beyond the ego vehicle.
Confirm traffic light network is active along the ego route with multiple signals visible in traffic_lights topics.
Check that at least one traffic light reports a red state before the anticipated intersection interaction.
Validate that final_waypoints are nonempty and consistently published from early in the route through the expected violation window.
post_execution_validation_rules: Confirm oracle flags a red-light violation for the ego; do not require lane invasion or collision for success.
Verify traffic_lights data include at least one red state in the time window immediately preceding the oracle red-light violation event.
Check that final_waypoints remain available and nonempty during the critical window leading up to the red-light violation.
Confirm that vehicle_cmd outputs remain effectively zero (throttle, brake, steer ≈ 0) while vehicle_status reports nonzero ego speed near and at the time of the oracle red-light violation.
Verify no additional dynamic actors influenced the ego at the time of violation (to match the no-extra-actors constraint).
If collision messages occur, record their presence and impulse but do not treat collision as required for matching this root-cause pattern.
uncertainty: Route–light association and whether the governing light’s stop line is actually crossed remain unknown and must not be assumed from traffic_lights alone.
Lane invasion is not required because dataset.xlsx and error.json conflict on lane_invasion status.
Any observed collision may be low severity or simulator-side and should not be assumed as core to the root cause.
The origin of the command–status mismatch (planning, control, simulator, or logging) cannot be inferred from this scenario alone.
